content: Laabappe Yaaqoobe Baqata
Laaba attuma nayti ba giddon, «Yaaqoobey nu aawa haaro ubbaa ekkides; hayssi ubbay izi shiishshida aqotay nu aawappe beettidaaza» gi haasayshin Yaaqoobey siyides.
Yaaqoobey Laaba ayfesoy izas kase mala gidonttayssa be7ides.
He wode GODAY Yaaqoobe, «Neni ne aawata biitta ne dabbotakko guye simma; tani nenara gidana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Yaaqoobey Eraheelonne Liya ba mehey dizaso yaana mala kiittidi xeygisides.
Izi isttas, «Intte aawa ayfesoy taas kaseyssa mala gidonttayssa tani be7adis; gido attiin ta aawa Xoossi tanara dees.
Tani ta kumeththa wolqqafe intte aawaas ooththidayssa intte ereeta.
Gido attiin intte aaway tana cimmidi ta damoza tammuto laammi laammi yeggides; gidikkoka izi tana qohontta mala Xoossi iza diggides.
Izi, ‹Masara dorsatinne deyshati ne damoza gidana› giin wude meheti wuri masara xalla yelida; qasse izi, ‹Xalaqa dorsatinne deyshatikka ne damoza gidana› giin mehey wuri xalaqa yelides.
Xoossi hayssaththo intte aawappe woththi ekkidi intte aawa mehe taas immides.
«Meheti meheteth keziza aginan agumora meheta mehessiza deysha orgeti masara, xalaqanne battaka gididayssa beyadis.
Xoossa kiitanchchay agumon tana, ‹Yaaqoobee!› gi xeygiin tani, ‹Yee!› gaada koyadis.
Izikka tana, ‹Dhoqqu gaada meheta mehetissiza deysha orgeti wuri masaranne xalaqa gididayssa beya; gaasoykka Laabay ne bolla ooththizayssa ubbaa ta beyadis.
Neni shuch essada zayte iza bolla tigada adinida Beetele Xoossi tana; ha7i dendada ha biittafe kezada elelada guye ne yelettida biitta simma› » gides.
Hessafe guye Eraheelanne Liyay izas, «Nu aawayssafe nuna gakkanay aazee?
Izi nuna allaga mala xeellees deennee? Izi nuna bayzi ekkides; bayzidi ekkida mishakka baas mi dhayssides.
Xoossi nu aawappe woththi ekkidi nees immida mehey wuri tumukka nuussanne nu naytayssa; hessa gishshas Xoossi nees yootidayssa ubbaa ooththa» gida.

Histtiin Yaaqoobey Kanaane biittan diza ba aawa Yisaaqakko baanaas dendides; izi ba naytanne ba machcheta gaamella togisides; baas diza mehe ubbaa sinththe aaththi laaggidi Mesphexoomiyan dishe izi shiishshida haaro ubbaa ekki bides.
Laabay ba dorsata iskeza qanxxanaas bichchidaashe Eraheela ba aawa eeqa misleta kaysadus.
Yaaqoobeykka ba baqatizayssa Aaraame dere asi gidida Laabas yootontta baleththi bides.
Izi baas dizaaz ubbaa shiishshi ekki baqatidi Efiraaxise Shaafaa pinnidi Gala7aade geetettiza gezze biitta bides.
Yaaqoobe Oykkanaas Laaba Kaaleteth
Yaaqoobey baqati bidayssa Laabay heedzdzanththo gallas siyides.
Ba dabbota banara ekkidi laappun gallassa oge Yaaqoobe guye kaallidi kaallidi Gala7aade geetettiza gezze biittan iza gakki oykkides.
He gallassa omars Xoossi Aaraame Laabakko agumora yiidi, «Neni Yaaqoobe bolla iita gidiin kiya gidiinkka haasayontta mala naageeta!» gides.
Laabay gakkiza wode Yaaqoobey Gala7aade gezzen dunkaani uttides; qasse Laabaynne iza dabboti heen dunkaane tokkida.
Hessafe guye Laabay Yaaqoobe, «Neni hayssaththo ays ooththadii? Neni tana cimmada ta macca nayta olan di7ettida mala laaggada kessadasa.
Neni ays qotan taappe kessa ekkada tana cimmadii? Tani karabeninne diiththan ufayssa yeththan nena moyzana mala taas ays yootabeekkii?
Neni haray atto ta nayta naytanne ta macca nayta tani yeera ekkontta mala diggadasa; neni balla ooso ooththadasa.
Tani nena qohanaas taas wolqqay dees; gido attiin ne aawa Xoossi qamma omars tana, ‹Yaaqoobe bolla iita gidiin kiya gidiinkka issi miish ne haasayontta mala naagetta!› giidi taas yootides.
Ha7i gidikkoka neni ne aawa soo baanaas keeha laamotida gishshas ke7adasa; gido attiin taso eeqa misleta aazas kaysadii?» gides.
Yaaqoobey Laaba, «Neni ne nayta taappe wolqqan woththa ekkanaakko gaada babbida gishshas hayssaththo ooththadis.

Gido attiin ne misleta oykkida as oonakka neni demmiko he uray hayqqo! Nees gidida miishshi ta achchan beettiko nu dabboti beyishin koyada demmiko nees ekka» gides; gaasoykka Yaaqoobey Eraheela eeqa misleta kaysidayssa eribeenna.
Hessa gishshas Laabay Yaaqoobe dunkaane giddo, Liya dunkaane giddonne nam7u aylleta dunkaane giddo gelides; gido attiin aykkoka demmibeenna; Liya dunkaanaappe kezidi Eraheeli dunkaane giddo gelides.
Eraheela ba aawa eeqa misleta ekkada gaamella koora garsan qottada, iza bolla uttadus. Laabay dunkaanan dizayssa ubbaa pilggidi koyides; gido attiin aykkoka demmibeenna.
Eraheela ba aawa, «Ta aawawu! Tana hanqettofa; tani nees eqqana dandaykke; taas maccassa wogay yides» gadus. Izi ubbason koyides; gido attiin eeqa misleta demmibeenna.
Yaaqoobey Laaba bolla hanqettidi, «Tani ay mooradinaa? Hessa sire ne tana kaallanaas tani ooththida nagaray aazee?
Ha7i neni ta miishshaa ubbaa pilggada koyadasashin ay demmadii? Istti neeppenne taappe ooni wordoko pirdana mala ha yo7oza ta dabbota sinththaninne ne dabbota sinththan woththa.
«Tani nenara nam7u tammu layth kumeth de7adis; ne dorsinne deysha gidiin awucaybeenna; woykko ne meheppe galth mabeekke.
Do7ay wodhidayssaka ubbaa ta bolla qoodadis attiin nees ehabeekke; gallas gidiin omars kaysoy ekkidayssa tana qanxxisadasa.
Gallas awa seelay, omars kenchchoy tana qohides; dhiskoyka ta ayfeppe dhaydes.

Tani hayssaththo ne soon nam7u tammu layth de7adis; ne macca naa nam7ata gishshas 14 layth, attida usuppun layth ne immida meheta gishshas nees ooththashe de7adis; gido attiin neni ta damoza tammuto laamma laamma yeggadasa.
Ta aawati Abrahaameynne Yisaaqi goynnida Xoossi tanara gidonttaakko ne tana mela kushe kessa yeddanakoshin Xoossi ta waayenne ta daabura be7idi qamma omars nena hanqides» gides.
Yaaqoobeynne Laabay Gelida Caaqo Qaala

Laabay Yaaqoobe, «Ne machcheti ta macca nayta; istti yelida naytikka ta nayta; mehezikka ta mehe; nees dizaazi wurikka tayssa; hach ha macca nayta tayta bollanne istti yelida nayta bolla ay ooththanaas dandayazinaa?
Ane ha7i haa ya; neninne tani caaqettoos; hayssi neeppenne taappe giddon markka gido» gides.
Hessa gishshas Yaaqoobey issi shuch ekkidi tuussa mala essides.
Izi ba dabbotakka, «Shuch shiishshite» gides; histtiin istti shuch shiishshidi korida; he shuchcha koraa achchanka kath mida.
Laabay he shuchcha koraa, Yigaar-Sahaaduta gi sunththides; qasse Yaaqoobey iza Gal7eede gi sunththides.
Laabay, «Ha keelay neeppenne taappe giddon hach markka» gides; hessa gishshas iza sunththay Gal7eede geetettides.
Qasse izi he shuchcha tuussaa Mixiphpha
gi sunththides; ays giikko Laabay, «Nuni issay issaafe haakkidi diza wode GODAY ne giddoninne ta giddon gididi naago.
Neni ta macca nayta qohiko, woykko neni ta macca nayta bolla hara maccassata ekkiko nunara ha7i oonikka baynda aggikokka ne giddoninne ta giddon Xoossay markka gididayssa era» gides.
Laabay qasseka Yaaqoobes, «Keelettida shuchchaa hayssa beya; qasse tani neeppenne taappe giddon essida shuchcha tuussa hayssa beya.

Tani ne bolla gene ooththanaas ha keelappe neekko kanththontta mala nenikka ta bolla gene ooththanaas ha keelappenne ha shuchchaa tuussaafe kanththontta mala ha shuchcha koraynne ha shuchcha tuussay markka.
Abrahaame Xoossi, Naakoore Xoossi, istta aawa Xoossi, izi nu giddon pirdo» gides. Yaaqoobey ba aawa Yisaaqi goynnida Xoossa sunththan caaqqides.
Yaaqoobey zumaa bollan yarsho yarshides; ba dabbotakka quma maanaas xeygides; istti miidi heen zuma bollan aqida.
Wonteththa gallas maalado wonttara Laabay dendidi ba nayta naytanne ba macca nayta anjjidinne yeeri ekkidi guye ba soo simmides.
